title: Profile library — visual directions
brief: Three light SolidCraft visual proposals for per-design saved sections, strict DXF preview and portable JSON catalogs. Fixed local demos only; no production functionality.

artboards.title: Explorer
artboards.tradeoff: Fast name scanning and generous section inspection; import occupies a permanent column.

artboards.title: Section gallery
artboards.tradeoff: Shape-first recognition; fewer profiles visible and more space used per section.

artboards.title: Docked workspace
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps modeling context visible; smaller inspection area and longer vertical flow.
